_note: Regression ceilings for `npm run perf` (CI job `perf`, also weekly), set 2026-10-30 from the measured medians of 3 runs in `_measured`. Rule: p50 fails at the next vsync above its median (a 30 fps regression fails); p95 and p99 keep one vsync step of slack; droppedPct is the median + 5 points (rounded up); fcp, heapMB, layerizeMs and minorGC are about 2x the median (layerizeMs at least 1 ms, minorGC at least 4). A budget moves only with new measured runs recorded here. droppedPct = dropped / (frames + dropped). A loaded machine fails them: the same demo in a 4-core container at load 17-26 measured p50 33.3, p95 50-100, 44-60% dropped, layerize 3.3-4.2 ms.
